audit: F2 bounded sidecar parsing and hashing

remove_ai_slops.notes: The bounded checks and descriptor helpers are justified at untrusted file and socket boundaries. Tests exercise observable rejects and do not merely assert removal.

programming.notes: The diff keeps typed domain errors and boundary validation. No untyped escape hatch, needless abstraction, or prompt/implementation-mirroring test was found in the audited behavior.

production_observables.observable: stat preflight plus counted readline(MAX_TOTAL_BYTES + 1) rejects total byte overflow before JSON decoding beyond the contract ceiling.
artifact validator opens O_NOFOLLOW rooted descriptors and hashes those descriptors in 64 KiB reads, preventing path-swap and whole-file hashing.
request-70 validates envelope length before reading its body and validates individual PNG/JSON lengths before parsing.

test_review.notes: The oversized-reader and Path.read_bytes guards bind the boundary requirements: reject before parsing and avoid whole-file hashing. They are targeted behavior tests, not request-removal pins.
